author: Nubbies231
body:
IGN: Nubbies231
Reason for Ban: Hacking - NoSlowdown
Banned By: FrostedCupcakes, January 30, 2016
Explanation: Can't really remember what I was doing, but I was probably hacking of the sort. So I apologize for doing that. Haven't played Minecraft in forever and the League of Legends servers are down and a buddy and I wanted to grind on some Avicus but I'm banned. All I'm doing is listening to his enjoyment over Skype. Sorry for anything that could've offended anyone and I'm hoping for a quick unban so I can come back and wreck some people.
